name: Cosmos Initia Co., Ltd.
summary: Cosmos Initia Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate sale, rental, and brokerage activities in Japan. It operates through Residential Business, Solution Business, Accommodation Business, and Construction Business segments. The company develops and sells condominium and single-family houses; post completion/move-in maintenance services; and acquisition/renovation/sale of existing condominiums. It also provides various solutions, such as sales/purchases and property management of investment real estate, and asset management/design/architectural consulting services; as well as develops and operates MIMARU apartment-style hotels.
